abstract: We here report a case of the gradual maturation of teratoma during 8 years after the initial chemotherapy. A 21-year-old man was diagnosed as having a left testicular tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis around the left renal artery in 1988 and high inguinal orchiectomy was carried out. Histological examination revealed a mixed germ cell tumor composed of immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and seminoma. He received four courses of PVB chemotherapy for his bulky lymph node metastasis. After normalization of the alpha-fetoprotein level, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) was performed. However, the nodes could not be dissected completely because of severe adhesions to the aorta. Histological examination revealed massive necrosis and immature teratoma. One cause of combination chemotherapy with cisplatin and etoposide was given following the surgery. In 1991, enlargement of the residual lymph nodes around the left renal artery was detected by CT scanning. Since both PVB chemotherapy and the combination of cisplatin with etoposide did not achieve remission, RPLND was performed again. Histological examination revealed a mature teratoma which was far more differentiated than that resected in 1988. In 1996, several enlarged para-aortic lymph nodes were found without the elevation of tumor makers, and en-bloc RPLND was performed. Microscopically, mature teratoma was observed in almost all specimens and, unexpectedly, adenocarcinoma was also observed in enteric elements of the mature teratoma. We concluded that we could not evaluate the malignant biological characteristics of teratoma from its maturation level and residual retroperitoneal teratomas should be as completely resected as possible.
abstract_ja: 本症例は、初回化学療法後8年間で奇形腫が徐々に成熟した症例を報告する。21歳男性が1988年に左精巣腫瘍と左腎動脈周囲の後腹膜リンパ節転移と診断され、高位精巣摘除術を施行された。組織学的検査で未熟奇形腫、胎児性癌、セミノーマからなる混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。巨大リンパ節転移に対しPVB療法を4コース施行した。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が正常化した後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を施行したが、大動脈への高度な癒着のため、節を完全に摘除できなかった。組織学的に大量の壊死と未熟奇形腫を認めた。術後にシスプラチンとエトポシドの併用化学療法を施行した。1991年、CTで左腎動脈周囲の残存リンパ節の増大を認めた。PVB療法およびシスプラチン・エトポシド療法はいずれも寛解を得られなかったため、再度RPLNDを施行した。組織学的に、1988年に切除されたものより分化の進んだ成熟奇形腫であった。1996年、腫瘍マーカーの上昇を伴わずに複数の傍大動脈リンパ節の増大を認め、一塊としてのen-bloc RPLNDを施行した。顕微鏡的には、ほぼすべての検体で成熟奇形腫を認め、予想外にも成熟奇形腫の腸管成分に腺癌も認めた。奇形腫の成熟度から悪性生物学的特性を評価することはできず、残存する後腹膜奇形腫は可能な限り完全切除すべきであると結論した。
